At Bluedot BPO Solutions, we connect top LATAM talent with high-performing U.S. teams. We are looking for an experienced and strategic Executive Recruiter to lead end-to-end hiring processes and support corporate talent acquisition for international clients.

This fully remote role offers daily exposure to the U.S. market and a clear growth path for professionals who want to build a long-term career in Talent Acquisition and HR leadership.


What We Offer


  • Compensation of R$5,000 + bonuses in USD
  • 100% remote, working directly with U.S. teams
  • Monday to Friday, 12PM – 21 PM (BRT)
  • Long-term position
  • Fast-track growth opportunities (Senior Recruiter, Lead, Manager)
  • International exposure and multicultural environment
  • Structured training and continuous coaching


Your Responsibilities


  • Manage full-cycle recruitment for corporate and strategic roles
  • Partner with stakeholders to align candidate profiles and hiring needs
  • Source, screen, and interview candidates for the U.S. market
  • Utilize tools such as LinkedIn Recruiter and ATS platforms
  • Manage and maintain healthy candidate pipelines
  • Ensure an excellent candidate experience end-to-end
  • Maintain consistent communication with hiring managers and candidates
  • Support strategic hiring initiatives for clients and internal teams


What We’re Looking For


  • 2+ years of experience with Hunting in the North-American Market
  • Proven experience in end-to-end recruitment
  • Strong English communication skills (professional level)
  • Highly organized and able to manage multiple requisitions
  • Detail-oriented, proactive, and delivery-focused
  • Comfortable in fast-paced environments


Nice to Have


  • Background in corporate or executive recruitment
  • Familiarity with LinkedIn Recruiter, Dynamics, or other ATS
  • Experience in high-volume or fast-paced hiring environments
  • Experience working with global stakeholders
  • Experience recruiting for international or U.S. clients is a strong plus



Technical Requirements


  • Two monitors
  • Laptop with i5/i7 (or equivalent) + 12GB RAM
  • High-speed internet
  • Headset with microphone
  • Quiet home office


Build your international career in Recruitment.


Work directly with U.S. teams and grow in a structured, high-performance environment.

title: Key Account Manager - Foco em Redes de Recarga
description:
Venha fazer parte da maior fabricante de medidores elétricos da América Latina!

Somos uma empresa de 95 anos que atua como provedora de tecnologia e soluções completas para o segmento de energia elétrica.

#VemSerNansen


Suas atividades serão:

  • Gestão de Relacionamento: Construir e manter relacionamentos sólidos com clientes estratégicos, atuando como ponto de contato principal.
  • Desenvolvimento de Negócios: Identificar oportunidades de crescimento dentro das contas existentes e propor soluções que agreguem valor.
  • Negociação e Contratos: Conduzir negociações comerciais, monitorar elaboração de propostas e monitorar processos de operações e pós-vendas.
  • Monitoramento de Performance: Acompanhar indicadores de vendas
  • Integração Interna: Trabalhar em conjunto com áreas de operações, marketing, pós vendas e financeiro para assegurar a execução eficiente das estratégias.
  • Inteligência de Mercado: Mapear tendências, concorrência e oportunidades no setor de distribuição e recarga.


Esta vaga é afirmativa e extensiva a toda a diversidade de pessoas, seja pela sua cor, etnia, gênero, religião, deficiência, faixa etária ou orientação sexual.


O que esperamos de você:

  • Vivência em setores de distribuição
  • Experiência em gestão de indicadores de performance (KPIs) e relatórios estratégicos.
  • Participação em projetos de expansão de canais de distribuição ou integração de soluções de recarga.
  • Formação em Engenharia Elétrica, Energia, Automação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Inglês avançado / fluente.


Confira nossos benefícios:

️ Vale-refeição (VR)

title: Technical Lead
description:
Project Description:

  • The Anaplan Technical Lead is an experienced multi-skilled professional with hands-on experience in Anaplan model development/Support experience. He/she is a good team player who is part of a team responsible for delivering end-to-end application development and Operations Support.


Responsibilities:

  • • Troubleshoot and provide solutions, Root Cause Analysis for incidents raised by business users/L1 team.
  • • Troubleshoot issues related to application access, process, scripts, etc.
  • • Handles Anaplan planned downtimes individually.
  • • In case of incident with a product quality issue, ensure PR is created and tagged against the incident before closing it.
  • • Perform UAT testing for projects owned by operations like new market adoption, simple logic change, etc.
  • • Prepare, present changes in change advisory board and own production implementation.
  • • Coordinate and manage discussions with other support teams and business users.
  • • Effectively communicate with stakeholders and business users.
  • • Think creatively to solve the user problem with a holistic and simple solution.
  • • Drive best practices within teams with respect to operations standards and guidelines.
  • • Ability to learn and adapt to new frameworks/technologies.


Mandatory Skills Description:

  • • Should have strong knowledge of Anaplan Connect, ALM Sync, NUX and Cloudworks.
  • • Anaplan Professional Model Builder / Professional Solution Architect Certified.
  • • Should have strong knowledge of troubleshooting and resolving incidents raised by business users and L1 Support.
  • • Good knowledge of troubleshooting and fixing job execution failures.
  • • Ability to analyse /root cause the PRs created for the Anaplan support models.
  • • Prior work experience in Anaplan Support projects.
  • Availability to work in US Central Time
  • Availability to regularly travel to St. Louis
  • • Good communication skills.


Nice-to-Have Skills Description:

  • • Basic knowledge of Cloud Services
  • • Knowledge in SRE, ITIL, AgileOps
  • • Able to work independently and interact with the business community, L3 team to come up with solutions.
  • • Knowledge of testing tools like Playwright / Selenium.

Experiência em prospecção ativa, negociação e manutenção de relacionamentos comerciais duradouros, sempre orientado a resultados e metas.


Com perfil comunicativo, persuasivo e analítico, atua identificando oportunidades de colaboração entre empresas, construindo propostas de valor personalizadas e garantindo a satisfação dos parceiros. title: Senior/Staff Platform Software Engineer (PHP/Angular)
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior/Staff Platform Software Engineer with 7+ years of experience to join our U.S. client. The role focuses on designing, building, and evolving the foundational systems that power the products. This role requires an experienced engineer with strong hands-on expertise in PHP and TypeScript (Angular) who can operate with minimal oversight and deliver pragmatic, customer-focused solutions.

The ideal candidate is an engineer who already possesses deep technical expertise, architectural judgment, and product-oriented thinking — and can apply those skills immediately in a production environment.

Our client provides integrated software and marketing solutions for the hospitality industry, specializing in short-term rental management. Their platform provides vacation rental companies with an enterprise-class property management system integrating booking, guest communications, and financial reporting systems - all built with partner organization integrations in mind.


Responsibilities

  • Design and implement scalable platform services using PHP as a primary backend language
  • Build and maintain frontend systems using TypeScript and Angular
  • Architect and evolve shared platform capabilities used across multiple products and teams
  • Translate product requirements into pragmatic, maintainable technical solutions
  • Apply Domain-Driven Design (DDD) principles and architectural modeling to complex business domains
  • Make sound tradeoffs between ideal architecture and practical delivery timelines
  • Build and integrate systems leveraging LLM-based tools to accelerate development workflows
  • Design and implement features powered by LLMs and agent-based systems, including orchestration, evaluation, and observability
  • Improve engineering velocity through tooling, automation, and thoughtful system design
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with product and design teams to ensure technical decisions align with customer needs
  • Contribute to cloud architecture decisions and ensure systems are scalable, secure, and cost-aware


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 7+ years of professional software engineering experience
  • Deep, production-grade experience with PHP
  • Strong front-end development experience using TypeScript and Angular
  • Experience designing and operating distributed systems in production
  • Strong understanding of API design, RESTful services, and event-driven systems and solid knowledge of relational databases and data modeling
  • Practical experience applying Domain-Driven Design (DDD) concepts and architectural models (layered architecture, hexagonal/clean architecture, event-driven architecture, etc.)
  • Demonstrated ability to evolve legacy systems incrementally
  • Ability to design systems that balance correctness, scalability, cost, and delivery speed
  • Hands-on experience deploying and operating systems in AWS, with familiarity with core AWS services (e.g., EC2, ECS/EKS, Lambda, RDS, S3, API Gateway, CloudWatch, IAM) and strong understanding of cloud-native patterns, scalability, reliability, and cost optimization
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation, CDK) is strongly preferred
  • Hands-on experience using LLM-based tools in daily development workflows
  • Experience integrating LLM APIs into production systems
  • Familiarity with prompt design, evaluation strategies, and reliability patterns
  • Ideally: experience building features or internal tools powered by LLM agents, including orchestration, tool use, guardrails, and monitoring
  • Strong product mindset with p ragmatic decision-maker — prioritizes customer impact over theoretical purity and avoids dogmatic adherence to patterns or tools
  • Experience making technical tradeoffs in ambiguous environments
  • Ability to reason about cost, complexity, maintainability, and time-to-market
  • Highly self-motivated and accountable, with the ability to drive initiatives independently from concept to production with minimal oversight
  • Comfortable operating in environments with evolving requirements


Desired Experience

  • Experience with other major cloud providers (GCP or Azure) is a plus
  • Experience defining platform strategy or technical direction across teams
  • Experience mentoring engineers and raising overall engineering standards
  • Proven track record of modernizing systems at scale
  • Experience designing developer platforms or internal tooling ecosystems
  • Strong opinions loosely held — able to debate rigorously and adapt when new information emerges


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Senior Frontend Developer
description:
A Arena.im é uma startup de IA do Vale do Silício , com um aporte de $16M e investida por CRV, Redpoint e Craft Ventures. Nossos clientes incluem ESPN, Red Bull, Disney e NFL . Junte-se ao time e ajude a construir aplicações em tempo real que atingem 180M de usuários mensais.


Na Arena, você vai trabalhar em problemas técnicos de verdade, em escala global:

  • Construir sistemas de mensagens em tempo real para suportar 500 mil+ usuários simultâneos por aplicação
  • Garantir alta disponibilidade em aplicações que rodam nas homepages e apps de alguns dos sites mais acessados da internet


O que buscamos:

  • 6+ anos de experiência relevante em desenvolvimento front-end
  • Perfil sênior, com forte capacidade de execução, autonomia e senso de urgência


Requisitos obrigatorios:

  • TypeScript
  • React
  • Next.js
  • GraphQL
  • Git
  • WebSocket


Diferenciais:

  • Styled Components
  • Gitflow
  • GitHub Actions
  • Gatsby
  • Webpack
  • Monorepo
  • Google Firebase / Firestore
  • Node.js


Exemplos de projetos em que você irá trabalhar:

  • Criar moderação para milhões de mensagens utilizando OpenAI SDK
  • Escalar chat em tempo real escalável para 1 milhão de usuários simultâneos
  • Implementação de widgets inspirados em produtos como Reddit, Discord e WhatsApp
  • Gerar enquetes automáticas utilizando AI e gerar insights


Beneficios:

Faça parte de uma empresa do Vale do Silício e trabalhe com um time global

Colabore com engenheiros de alto nível, com forte expertise em AI Agents

Pacote de compensação competitivo e benefícios. Pagamos em dólares ou em reais.

⛱️ 5 semanas de férias remuneradas

Orçamento para aprendizado e desenvolvimento

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
A Immunomatics é uma startup sediada em San Diego, Califórnia, com a missão de melhorar os desfechos dos transplantes de órgãos por meio da seleção otimizada de doadores assistida por inteligência artificial (IA).


A empresa busca contratar profissionais brasileiros com conhecimento avançado em arquiteturas de deep learning.


Responsabilidades

  • Projetar, implementar, testar e validar modelos de IA para estratificação de risco.


O que buscamos

  • Pós-graduação em Ciência, Tecnologia, Engenharia ou Matemática.
  • Publicação de artigos científicos envolvendo o uso de redes neurais.
  • Experiência em projetar e implementar novas arquiteturas de redes neurais ou em personalizar arquiteturas existentes (CNN, RNN, Autoencoders, Transformers, etc.) para melhorar o desempenho preditivo do modelo.
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento de métodos e ferramentas computacionais.
  • Fortes habilidades analíticas e de resolução de problemas.
  • Fluência em inglês.
  • Bônus: Experiência em Bioinformática.

title: Arquiteto de TI
description:
A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital.


Somos globais, somos GPTW.


♿️ Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys!

Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD). Caso você se enquadre ou conheça alguém com o perfil, a Foursys é a empresa ideal!

Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:


Principais Responsabilidades

• Projetar, documentar e evoluir a arquitetura de soluções tecnológicas, garantindo alinhamento com as estratégias de negócio e padrões corporativos.

• Apoiar o desenho de soluções integradas, considerando escalabilidade, segurança, performance e interoperabilidade.

• Elaborar artefatos técnicos como diagramas de arquitetura, fluxos de integração e especificações de alto nível.

• Avaliar tecnologias, frameworks e ferramentas que suportem as necessidades de negócio e TI.

• Atuar como ponte entre times de desenvolvimento, infraestrutura, segurança e áreas de negócio.

• Participar de análises de viabilidade técnica e estimativas de esforço em novos projetos e demandas.

• Apoiar a governança de arquitetura, zelando pela padronização e aderência aos princípios da empresa.

• Contribuir para a evolução de arquiteturas legadas, promovendo modernização e transformação digital.

• Elaborar a arquitetura de soluções para novos projetos e evoluções de sistemas existentes.

• Criar e manter atualizados os artefatos técnicos relacionados à arquitetura (diagramas, especificações, modelos de integração).

• Apoiar as áreas de negócio e desenvolvimento na definição de soluções tecnológicas.

• Realizar avaliação técnica de propostas, tecnologias e ferramentas.

• Garantir a aderência aos padrões de segurança, qualidade, escalabilidade e governança de TI.

• Atuar na identificação e mitigação de riscos arquiteturais em projetos e soluções.

• Apoiar a disseminação de boas práticas de arquitetura entre os times de tecnologia.

• Contribuir com a evolução dos frameworks, padrões e diretrizes de arquitetura corporativa.


Requisitos técnicos:

• Certificação AZ-900 Microsoft Azure

• Conhecimento em padrões de arquitetura (MVC, SOA, Microserviços, Event-Driven, entre outros).

• Experiência com APIs, barramento de serviços (ESB), integrações e arquitetura orientada a serviços.

• Conhecimentos em segurança da informação aplicada à arquitetura.

• Domínio de ferramentas de modelagem como Enterprise Architect, Draw.io, ArchiMate, Lucidchart, entre outras.

• Capacidade de definir e aplicar princípios de arquitetura corporativa e governança de TI.


Formato de trabalho: Home office


E temos também o Clube da Four que oferece ótimas vantagens!

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Buscamos um Desenvolvedor .NET & Angular com sólida experiência no desenvolvimento, testes e manutenção de aplicações Web, APIs e integrações, utilizando bancos de dados SQL/Oracle/Postgres como backend. O profissional atuará na criação de soluções escaláveis, sustentáveis e alinhadas às melhores práticas do mercado, contribuindo ativamente com análises, arquitetura e qualidade do código.

Responsabilidades

  • Atuar no desenvolvimento e integração de aplicações Web, APIs e componentes utilizando .NET, .NET Core, Angular, JavaScript, jQuery, CSS e bancos de dados relacionais.
  • Desenvolver Web Forms, aplicações MVC e APIs para apoiar funções de negócio.
  • Participar da análise de requisitos, propondo soluções técnicas e contribuindo com o design e a arquitetura de software.
  • Realizar troubleshooting, identificar problemas e sugerir padrões e melhorias baseadas em ocorrências recorrentes.
  • Fornecer orientação técnico-funcional, compreendendo o negócio, ecossistema e soluções já existentes.
  • Garantir a qualidade do código por meio de testes, revisão de código e documentação.
  • Participar de reuniões de planejamento e entrega com o time de desenvolvimento e gestão.
  • Produzir documentação adequada em todas as etapas do SDLC (Software Development Life Cycle).
  • Sugerir soluções criativas e alternativas técnicas sempre que aplicável.
  • Trabalhar de forma independente, com mínima supervisão, entregando resultados consistentes.
  • Aplicar boas práticas de programação, conhecimento sólido em OOP e padrões de desenvolvimento.
  • (Desejável) Conhecimento em Python para backend.

Qualificações Técnicas (Obrigatórias)

  • Sólida de experiência em desenvolvimento com .NET C#, Web Forms, MVC, Angular, JavaScript e jQuery.
  • Experiência prática em projetos Angular.
  • Forte expertise em .NET e .NET Core, com bom entendimento de Web API, REST e protocolos HTTP.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de versionamento como TFS, GitHub ou Git.
  • Conhecimento de frameworks de logging como Microsoft Enterprise Library, log4Net, Azure Application Insights, entre outros.
  • Entendimento de provedores de nuvem e seus componentes para implementação de soluções.
  • Ótima compreensão de padrões de projeto, arquitetura e boas práticas para melhoria de performance.
  • Experiência com Angular/ReactJS (desejável) e Vue.js (desejável).
  • Conhecimento em DevOps/DevSecOps.
  • Capacidade de realizar análises complexas e pesquisas técnicas detalhadas quando necessário.

title: AI Automation Specialist | Ecommerce (Full-time Remote, BR)
description:
Carepod is a growing premium humidifier brand operating in the US, Canada, and Australia . We’re looking for an AI Automation Specialist to eliminate manual work and build smart, reliable workflows across the business.



What You’ll Do


  • Build AI-powered automations for marketing, operation, CS, and reporting system throughout company
  • Connect tools like Shopify, Asana, Google Workspace, Zendesk
  • Design workflows using Zapier / Make / n8n + LLMs like ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, etc
  • Identify inefficiencies and turn them into systems



What We’re Looking For


  • 3+ years in automation / ops / systems roles
  • Hands-on experience with no-code / low-code tools
  • Strong business process thinking
  • Clear English communication
  • Bonus: ecommerce, Python, security-minded builds



How to Apply


  • Apply with your resume or LinkedIn profile.

title: Salesforce Business System Analyst
description:
Job Title: Salesforce Business Systems Analyst (BSA)

Location: LATAM

Duration: 6-12months

Job Summary:

We are looking for a Salesforce Business Systems Analyst (BSA) with strong experience in gathering business requirements, translating them into functional specifications, and supporting Salesforce implementation and enhancements. The ideal candidate will work closely with business stakeholders, product owners, and technical teams to deliver scalable Salesforce solutions that support business processes.

Key Responsibilities:

·Work with business stakeholders to gather, analyze, and document business requirements for Salesforce implementations and enhancements.

·Translate business needs into functional requirements, user stories, and process flows .

·Act as a bridge between business teams and technical teams to ensure accurate implementation of requirements.

·Configure and support Salesforce features including Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, workflows, validation rules, reports, and dashboards .

·Participate in solution design discussions and recommend best practices within the Salesforce ecosystem.

·Support UAT (User Acceptance Testing) by preparing test cases, coordinating with stakeholders, and ensuring requirements are met.

·Assist in data migration, integration requirements, and system documentation .

·Provide production support and troubleshooting for Salesforce issues.

·Maintain clear documentation including BRDs, FRDs, user stories, and process diagrams .

·Collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive continuous improvement and system optimization .

Required Qualifications:

·3–6 years of experience as a Business Analyst with Salesforce platform exposure .

·Strong understanding of Salesforce Sales Cloud and/or Service Cloud .

·Experience with requirements gathering, documentation, and stakeholder management .

·Knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodologies .

·Ability to create user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional specifications .

·Experience with Salesforce reporting, dashboards, and basic configuration .

·Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills

title: Analista de Engenharia Jr. – Projetos de Saneamento
description:
A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.


Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.


A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Apoiar as áreas de engenharia (projetos, obras, planejamento, operação e manutenção);
  • Participar da elaboração de projetos de redes de água, esgoto, drenagem e sistemas de bombeamento;
  • Acompanhar a execução de projetos e propor melhorias técnicas;
  • Apoiar estudos de viabilidade técnica e ambiental;
  • Monitorar indicadores e apoiar análises de desempenho;
  • Elaborar relatórios técnicos, planilhas e apresentações;
  • Atuar de forma preventiva na identificação de riscos e oportunidades nos projetos.


Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação em Engenharia Civil, Engenharia Ambiental ou Arquitetura;
  • Conhecimento em AutoCAD;
  • Conhecimento em Excel;
  • Experiência ou familiaridade com projetos de engenharia e/ou saneamento.
  • Perfil dinâmico, com capacidade de lidar com múltiplas demandas.
  • Residir em Belém/PA.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens.


Diferenciais

  • Conhecimento em QGIS ou ferramentas de geoprocessamento;
  • Noções de topografia;
  • Experiência com acompanhamento de obras ou projetos em campo;


Informações adicionais


  • Assistência médica;
  • Assistência odontológica;
  • Zenklub (atendimento direcionado à saúde mental e nutricional);
  • Serviço de assistência gratuito (social, jurídico e financeiro);
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Vale transporte;
  • Gympass;
  • Vale alimentação e/ou refeição;
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados;
  • Kit office.

title: Analista de Suporte de Sistemas Pleno
description:
Sobre a vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Suporte a Sistemas Pleno para atuar no atendimento e resolução de incidentes em sistemas internos. Este(a) profissional será responsável por realizar análises técnicas iniciais, identificar causas de problemas e atuar de forma colaborativa com times de desenvolvimento para garantir a continuidade e estabilidade das aplicações.


Responsabilidades

  • Realizar atendimento de incidentes em nível L1/L2
  • Executar análise inicial de problemas e troubleshooting básico
  • Investigar logs e dados para identificação de falhas
  • Abrir e analisar código da aplicação para diagnóstico de issues
  • Atuar na resolução de problemas relacionados a banco de dados
  • Escalar incidentes quando necessário, com diagnóstico detalhado
  • Interagir com times técnicos (desenvolvimento e infraestrutura)
  • Garantir registro e documentação adequada dos atendimentos


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Experiência prévia com suporte a sistemas
  • Capacidade de análise inicial de incidentes e troubleshooting
  • Conhecimento intermediário em PostgreSQL (queries, análise de logs e troubleshooting)
  • Conhecimento em SQL
  • Capacidade de leitura e análise de código para identificação de problemas


Requisitos desejáveis

  • Conhecimento em IDE Visual Studio
  • Noções de desenvolvimento em .NET
  • Experiência com sistemas internos corporativos
  • Familiaridade com processos de sustentação (suporte corretivo e evolutivo)

title: Lead Backend Java Engineer with Devops
description:
Principal Java Engineer - Full Stack Backend Engineer with DevOps experience

Shift Timings: USA, PST (Pacific Standard Time)

Location: Remote (Brazil)


We're seeking a seasoned Java Engineer who can own services end-to-end, from development through production infrastructure management.


What You'll Do:

  • Design and build scalable APIs and backend services using Java
  • Implement security best practices including authentication, authorization, and secure coding
  • Develop event-driven architectures using Kafka
  • Design and optimize PostgreSQL databases
  • Manage infrastructure as code using Terraform
  • Deploy and orchestrate services with Kubernetes


What We're Looking For:

  • 10+ years of Java development experience (Spring Boot preferred)
  • Strong API development and RESTful design skills
  • Hands-on experience with Kafka and PostgreSQL
  • Proven ability with Terraform and Kubernetes
  • Security-minded approach to development
  • Experience with microservices architecture
  • Ability to own projects from concept to production


Requirements:

  • Must have overlapping working hours with PST (Pacific Standard Time)
  • Strong communication skills in English
  • Self-starter who can work independently

title: UX & Data-Driven Usability Designer
description:
UX & Data-Driven Usability Designer


About the Role

We are looking for a UX & Data-Driven Usability Designer to help improve the performance of a large-scale digital commerce platform. This role focuses on identifying friction in critical customer journeys and delivering usability improvements that directly impact conversion.


You will own the Usability workstream, partnering closely with product and analytics teams to analyze user behavior, uncover drop-off points, and design improvements across key transactional flows such as cart, checkout, and payment.


This role is ideal for a designer who combines strong UX thinking with analytical rigor and enjoys working in fast-moving consulting environments where rapid insights and quick wins are highly valued.


What You’ll Do

  • Lead usability analysis across critical customer journeys including product discovery, cart, checkout, and payment.
  • Conduct funnel analysis to identify friction points and conversion drop-offs throughout the purchase process.
  • Partner with product and analytics teams to analyze quantitative data such as conversion rates, abandonment points, and user behavior patterns.
  • Map end-to-end customer journeys to identify quick wins and usability improvements that can drive immediate conversion gains.
  • Design and prototype improvements to transactional flows, focusing on reducing friction and simplifying the purchasing experience.
  • Present insights and design recommendations to stakeholders, clearly tying usability improvements to measurable business impact.
  • Work within a fast-paced consulting team delivering iterative improvements across short delivery cycles.


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in UX design or product design
  • Strong experience with data-driven design approaches, including funnel analysis and conversion optimization
  • Ability to collaborate with product and analytics teams to interpret quantitative data and translate insights into UX improvements
  • Experience mapping end-to-end user journeys and identifying usability improvements
  • Proven experience redesigning transactional flows such as cart, checkout, or payment experiences
  • Strong problem-solving and research skills
  • Fluency in Portuguese (required working language)
  • Comfort working in fast-paced consulting environments with tight delivery timelines


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with A/B testing frameworks and experimentation programs
  • Background designing for marketplace platforms or high-traffic e-commerce products
  • Experience in consulting or agency environments with frequent stakeholder presentations
  • Familiarity with qualitative usability testing methods, including user interviews and moderated testing


This role offers the opportunity to combine UX design and analytics to drive measurable improvements in customer experience and platform performance. If you enjoy solving complex usability challenges and turning data into impactful design decisions, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Cientista de Dados Especialista em IA
description:
A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital.


Somos globais, somos GPTW.


♿️ Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys!


Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD). Caso você se enquadre ou conheça alguém com o perfil, a Foursys é a empresa ideal!


Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:


Cientista de Dados Especialista em IA


Descrição da posição


Profissional atuará no desenvolvimento de soluções baseadas em LLMs (Large Language Models), com foco na criação de prompts avançados e agentes de IA, apoiando a evolução de soluções analíticas aplicadas a produtos e plataformas digitais.


A atuação envolve o desenvolvimento de Prompt Engineering, integração com dados estruturados e não estruturados e construção de agentes inteligentes, garantindo qualidade, governança e confiabilidade das respostas geradas pelos modelos.


Responsabilidades


Desenvolver, testar e refinar prompts utilizando técnicas avançadas de Prompt Engineering, como Chain-of-Thought, Few-shot e ReAct

Criar e evoluir agentes de IA baseados em LLMs

Avaliar a performance de diferentes modelos e agentes para casos de uso específicos

Preparar e estruturar dados estruturados e não estruturados para alimentar modelos de linguagem

Garantir que prompts e agentes sigam diretrizes de segurança, governança e ética, evitando alucinações e outputs inconsistentes

Atuar em conjunto com diferentes áreas para integrar soluções de IA generativa em produtos e sistemas

Apoiar na construção de mecanismos de monitoramento e avaliação de outputs gerados por agentes de IA


Requisitos obrigatórios


Formação em Estatística, Matemática, Engenharia, Ciência da Computação, Física ou áreas correlatas

Experiência prática no desenvolvimento de prompts e agentes de IA utilizando sistemas baseados em LLMs

Domínio de Python

Experiência em manipulação e análise de dados utilizando SQL

Experiência com modelagem preditiva e machine learning

Conhecimento do mercado de crédito ou produtos financeiros


  • Idioma: Inglês é considerado um diferencial, mas não obrigatório


E temos o Clube da Four que oferece ótimas vantagens!

title: Virtual Executive Assistant – Family Owned Business Group
description:
Summary

We are a family-owned business group overseeing a diversified portfolio of ventures across healthcare (medical practices), luxury travel, and Broadway / live entertainment production .

Our organization supports multiple senior executives who operate at the intersection of medicine, entrepreneurship, real estate, travel, and the performing arts . We are seeking a highly proactive, detail-oriented Virtual Executive Assistant to provide executive-level administrative and operational support across the group and help streamline day-to-day execution as our businesses continue to grow.


This is a unique opportunity to work closely with leadership across multiple industries , gaining exposure to complex operations, high-level decision-making, and creative as well as clinical environments.


Responsibilities

  • Manage and optimize executive calendars across multiple businesses, including coordinating meetings across time zones and balancing competing priorities
  • Serve as a primary communication liaison , screening and prioritizing emails, calls, and messages to ensure timely and appropriate responses
  • Coordinate travel arrangements including flights, accommodations, ground transportation, and detailed itineraries for business and personal travel
  • Prepare meeting materials , agendas, briefing notes, and follow-up summaries to ensure action items are tracked and completed
  • Conduct research on vendors, partners, venues, travel options, market opportunities, and industry trends to support executive decision-making
  • Manage relationships with vendors and external service providers , including medical offices, travel partners, production vendors, accountants, and legal teams
  • Organize and maintain digital filing systems across multiple entities, ensuring documents are secure, accessible, and well categorized
  • Assist with special projects , including event coordination, content creation, process documentation, operational improvements, and cross-business initiatives
  • Handle personal administrative tasks as needed to support executive productivity and work-life balance

Qualifications

  • 2–5 years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Virtual Assistant, or similar high-level administrative role supporting senior leaders
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to represent executives professionally across industries
  • Highly resourceful and high-agency , with a demonstrated ability to anticipate needs and solve problems independently
  • Advanced proficiency with productivity tools including Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets) , Zapier, Zoom, and project management platforms
  • Strong organizational skills with experience managing complex schedules and competing priorities
  • Proven track record of maintaining strict confidentiality and exercising sound judgment with sensitive information
  • Reliable high-speed internet and a dedicated home office setup
  • Availability to work during overlapping U.S. Eastern Time hours

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting founders, physicians, or executives across multiple businesses
  • Familiarity with CRM systems, expense management, invoicing, and basic bookkeeping
  • Experience coordinating events, travel, or live productions
  • Comfort working in both clinical / professional and creative / entertainment environments
  • Bilingual capabilities (Spanish is a plus but not required)
  • Experience with Notion, Hubspot and Zapier

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation commensurate with experience
  • Opportunity to work directly with senior leadership across healthcare, luxury travel, and Broadway / live entertainment
  • Exposure to a diversified business portfolio , not a single company role
  • Flexible, remote-first work environment with an emphasis on results over hours
  • Long-term growth potential for the right candidate who becomes a trusted operational partner

title: Salesforce Data Cloud Developer
description:
Job Summary

Client is looking for Salesforce Data Cloud who can support from Brazil or Argentina

  • Familiarity with AI-driven customer engagement platforms like Agentforce.
  • Proven ability to lead complex multi-cloud Salesforce implementations.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodologies.

title: Murex Back Office Developer (EST working hours)
description:
Summary

DXC-Luxoft has one of the world's leading Solutions practices. We are a top-tier Murex Alliance Partner and a market leader in implementation, integration, upgrade and migration. We provide end-to end project services and have delivered over 200 successful Murex projects across all major asset-classes and sectors including investment banking, asset management, corporate treasury and insurance.


We're looking for Senior Murex Back Office / Operations Developer with hands-on experience with MxML, DataMart, Batch processing and EOD flows.


Working hours: EST zone with some flexibility.


Responsibilities

  • Level 3 support to Back-Office end-user issues on both functional, technical
  • Liaise with respective internal team(s) to resolve issues and necessary enhancements
  • Develop requirements per given stream and according with resolution needs as they come along
  • Manage day-to-day assigned tasks to complete various application support deliverables
  • Contribute to support group(s) efforts in resolving request or issues
  • Analyze, formulate, proposed, develop and/or contribute to overall solutions as per project deliverables
  • Continuous follow-up of new Application developments, enhancements, version upgrade release, regulations/practices globally, and other such items
  • Perform various levels of testing for assigned deliverables as well as participate in formal release cycles (SIT/UAT)


Requirements

  • 3+ years' hands-on experience with Murex Back-Office functionalities (Senior level skills in pre-trade (MSL) and post-trade Murex workflows such as Contract, Events, Deliverables and/or Exchange)
  • Hands-on experience in MxML, Datamart, Batch processing, End of Day flow(s), interfaces and Trade Life Cycle
  • Knowledge in SQL (Oracle and/or Sybase) and Unix commands
  • Must have strong personality, logical and analytical skills
  • Be detailed-oriented, a quick learner and self-starter
  • Possess good verbal and written communication skills
  • Must have strong organization skills
  • Good product knowledge in IRD, CRD, EQD
  • Good understanding on P&L concept overall and its components
  • Strong problem solving skills and attention to detail
  • Strong relationship building skills both internally and externally
  • Strong experience in supporting end-users and resolving their daily issues


Nice-to-have

  • BS or higher degree in Finance, Mathematics, Computer Science or equivalent
  • Implementations and upgrades: MXpress; MXplus updates and MX.3 main-branch upgrades
  • Interfaces (Market Data, C2.0)
  • Test management
  • Market Data management
  • Client focus: understands clients' businesses; identifies and understands the needs and objectives of clients, both on an individual and corporate basis; builds strong relationships to aid Luxoft's aim of being a trusted partner to the clients.
  • Communication skills: expresses ideas effectively, both verbally and in writing; adjusts language, terminology and non-verbal communication as appropriate.
  • Teamwork: works effectively with others; helps to build strong teams and networks.
  • Personal leadership: realistically identifies own skills, experience, knowledge and other personal attributes; displays confidence and resilience.
  • Planning and organizing: identifies and meets milestones; understands and articulates deliverables; assesses and mitigates risks; sticks to the scope of work and manages any changes.
  • Analytical decision-making: identifies and solves problems using insight and experience to make good decisions; gathers relevant information, identifying important issues and drawing conclusions

title: Desenvolvedor full stack Java com Angular
description:
Cód. 58788


Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Temos 2.500 funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


  • Ei Dev, venha fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país!


- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?

  • Frontend: experiência sólida com Angular e/ou React (construção de interfaces, componentes e integração com APIs).
  • Backend: desenvolvimento em Java e/ou Python , com APIs e serviços escaláveis.
  • AWS (imprescindível): experiência prática em serviços AWS em ambiente produtivo (deploy, operação, integração e boas práticas).
  • Arquitetura moderna: domínio de arquitetura de microserviços e micro frontend (desenho, implementação e integração entre domínios/equipes).


- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Senior Content Manager
description:
As a Senior Content Manager, you will play a key role in supporting MoveUp Media’s growth by owning the operational and strategic execution of content across our website portfolio. You will take ownership of content performance and strategy across our websites, while leading day-to-day content operations and working closely with SEO and cross-functional teams. You will be responsible for turning content and SEO strategies into measurable results, while ensuring high-quality standards across multi-language teams and markets.


This role contributes directly to the CORE department’s objectives by supporting the growth, stability, and diversification of the business through content performance, strong processes, and effective collaboration. You will act as the main point of ownership for content quality and delivery, working closely with SEO, Product, and cross-functional teams.


To be more specific, you will:


  • Lead and develop the content strategy for our flagship, multi-language websites across multiple markets
  • Manage content workflows and ensure consistent, high-quality output across all sites
  • Oversee content quality, structure, and standards across our portfolio
  • Work proactively with content teams to define and implement content checklists and best practices
  • Collaborate closely with SEO, Tech, Design, and Product teams to ensure content and SEO best practices are followed
  • Ensure all SEO and content checks are completed ahead of website launches or redesigns
  • Regularly review websites to identify issues, suggest improvements, and support teams with implementation
  • Monitor content performance and report progress and key initiatives to senior stakeholders
  • Ensure content meets compliance and regulatory requirements and oversee necessary updates
  • Stay up to date with market trends, best practices, and iGaming innovations
  • Support hiring and team development (mentoring) in collaboration with Talent Acquisition and HR.


The ideal profile


We’re looking for a Senior Content Manager ready to step into a Lead role — someone who takes ownership of content performance, works independently, and collaborates closely with SEO to drive results.


You are someone who:


  • Has 3+ years of experience in a senior content or content leadership role
  • Has iGaming experience (a strong plus, not a must)
  • Has a background in journalism, communications, or a related field (a plus)
  • Has an excellent command of English and a strong eye for content quality and consistency
  • Is comfortable reviewing and optimising content rather than writing it


You bring strong CM fundamentals:


  • High level of autonomy and strong task prioritisation skills
  • Ownership mindset over site and content performance
  • Ability to analyse performance data and turn insights into clear actions
  • Strategic thinking and the ability to plan toward defined goals
  • Experience working with CMS platforms


You work well with others and think ahead:


  • Collaborative approach, especially when working with SEO teams
  • Proactive in sharing ideas, flagging issues, and suggesting improvements
  • Open to experimentation, innovation, and continuous improvement
  • Positive attitude with a growth mindset and leadership potential


Feeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We're eager to hear from you! We know not all great candidates will match 100% of the above.


Next steps in the process ✅


  • 1rst Interview with your future manager to make sure you meet the role’s requirements
  • 2nd interview with HR to better understand who you are and make sure there is a cultural fit with MoveUp Media
  • Last step: a proposition for us to start working together!


What’s in it for you


  • A full time remote work environment.
  • A flexible schedule and paid time off. We measure results , not hours.
  • Competitive salary, depending on your level of seniority in the role and your location
  • Development opportunities. As a startup with rapid growth, there are a lot of possibilities that can arise and we are committed to accompany our team members in their career path.
  • Yearly get together with the team to connect, work and have fun . We strive to find good spots for everyone to enjoy the stay!


MoveUp Media

title: Office Coordinator
description:
Role Description

This is a full-time remote position for an Office Coordinator. The Office Coordinator will manage daily operations by providing administrative assistance, handling communications, and maintaining office systems and equipment. Additional responsibilities include managing schedules, responding to inquiries, assisting with customer service activities, and ensuring smooth internal processes across the organization.


Qualifications

  • Experience with Administrative Assistance and proficiency in handling Office Equipment
  • Strong Phone Etiquette and Customer Service skills
  • Excellent Communication skills, both written and verbal
  • Organizational and time management abilities
  • Proficiency with office software and tools
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment
  • Prior experience in office coordination or similar roles is a plus

title: AI Data Engineer - 131496
description:
O que buscamos:

Profissional de nível Pleno/Sênior que atue com (Dados/IA).

Responsabilidades:

  • Atuar como referência técnica na construção de soluções agentic unindo engenharia de dados em Azure e Copilot Studio;
  • Projetar e desenvolver pipelines de dados em Azure Data Factory e/ou Databricks, preparando bases confiáveis para consumo por agentes de IA;
  • Construir e evoluir agentes no Copilot Studio, incluindo tópicos, ações, fluxos, conectores e integrações com sistemas corporativos;
  • Implementar padrões de RAG: curadoria de fontes, chunking, embeddings, estratégias de busca e governança do conteúdo utilizado pelos agentes;
  • Integrar agentes a dados corporativos via APIs, conectores e camadas analíticas (Lakehouse, SQL, semantic models), garantindo rastreabilidade de respostas;
  • Definir e supervisionar padrões de observabilidade: logs, telemetria, métricas de uso, qualidade de resposta e monitoramento de falhas ponta a ponta;
  • Atuar com segurança e governança: controle de acesso, proteção de dados sensíveis, auditoria e conformidade com LGPD;
  • Apoiar o time em design reviews, troubleshooting de pipelines e agentes, otimização de performance e resolução de incidentes complexos.

Requisitos :

  • Formação e experiência sólida como Engenheiro(a) de Dados em Azure;
  • Experiência com Copilot Studio (criação de copilots, tópicos, actions, conectores, publicação e gestão de ambientes);
  • Experiência com pipelines em Azure Data Factory e/ou Databricks;
  • Domínio de Python e SQL para transformação e automação;
  • Conhecimento prático de RAG, embeddings, vetorização e estratégias de recuperação de informação;
  • Experiência com integrações via REST APIs e conectores corporativos;
  • Conhecimento sólido em segurança (RBAC, Key Vault, identities) e práticas de auditoria/compliance;
  • Vivência com Git e CI/CD para versionamento e promoção entre ambientes.

Diferencial:

  • Experiência com Microsoft Fabric (Lakehouse, Data Pipelines, Dataflows Gen2, Semantic Model);
  • Vivência com Azure AI Foundry e/ou Azure OpenAI para orquestração e avaliação de modelos;
  • Experiência com Power Platform (Power Automate, Dataverse) e conectores avançados;
  • Implementação de guardrails: content filters, políticas, grounding, fallback e segurança de prompts
  • Observabilidade e avaliação de agentes: testes, métricas de qualidade, feedback loop e melhoria contínua;
  • Certificações Azure (DP-203, AI-102, PL-600/PL-700) e/ou Microsoft Applied Skills.

Descrição comportamental:

Procuramos uma pessoa que:

  • Goste de trabalhar em equipe e seja colaborativa em suas atribuições;
  • Tenha coragem para se desafiar e ir além, abraçando novas oportunidades de crescimento;
  • Transforme ideias em soluções criativas e busque qualidade em toda sua rotina;
  • Tenha habilidades de resolução de problemas ;
  • Possua habilidade e se sinta confortável para trabalhar de forma independente e gerenciar o próprio tempo ;
  • Tenha interesse em lidar com situações adversas e inovadoras no âmbito tecnológico.

Big enough to deliver – small enough to care.

Na Jaya Tech, acreditamos na Engenharia de Software Consciente, uma abordagem inovadora, e por isso oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho inspirador, focado em promover o autoconhecimento, tomar decisões embasadas em dados, cultivar relacionamentos saudáveis e entender o impacto do nosso trabalho. Aqui, você encontrará oportunidades para crescimento profissional e pessoal, contribuindo para projetos que têm um impacto significativo na indústria e na sociedade.


Sobre o Projeto

Você fará parte de um time de um dos maiores bancos digitais do Brasil, contribuindo para a transformação digital desse setor.


Você é curioso, criativo, valoriza cultura de feedbacks entre outras boas práticas? Então, essa vaga é para você!

Estamos buscando um Desenvolvedor Backend Senior para atuar com Java ou Kotlin em um time inovador. Se essa é sua vibe e você quer fazer parte de um ambiente desafiador, venha conversar com a gente!


Atuação 100% remota | Forma de contratação: CLT | Remuneração: Reais | Full-time | Range: 11K a 15K


Requisitos:

Experiência em Kotlin ou Java (Backend)

Conhecimento em Spring Boot

Vivência com Microserviços

Familiaridade com Testes unitários e de integração

Experiência com Docker ou Kubernetes

Participação em processos de revisão de código

Habilidade em depuração de problemas

Experiência com metodologias ágeis


Por que essa vaga pode ser ideal pra você?

Ambiente de aprendizado contínuo e espaço para crescimento

Time comprometido com excelência técnica

Cultura de feedback

Autonomia e respeito


Benefícios

Plano de Saude, Odontologico, Seguro de Vida, Aulas de Ingles, Auxilio Psicologico

title: Senior Technical Analyst
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for an experienced Senior Technical Analyst with minimum 7 years of experience with Solaris/AIX/Linux, WebSphere, WebLogic or JBoss and various middleware infrastructure technologies.


Responsibilities:


· Evaluate, design, document, install, test, implement, monitors and maintain complex UNIX/Linux based applications such as GPP, GCP, Total Payments, and infrastructure solutions

· Configuring and support of production, testing and development environments (Solaris/AIX/Linux)

· Troubleshooting, Preparing, updating, and maintaining technical documentation and RFPs

· Capacity planning, DR configuration, and High Availability implementation and testing

· Evaluate, recommend, installs and configure tools for event monitoring, capacity planning, performance monitoring on UNIX/Linux systems providing automated 24/7 production application and system monitoring

· Conduct technical training


Must-Have Skills:


· Relevant academic background

· Good understanding of GPP SP & Total Payments deployment architecture

· Minimum 7 years of technical work experience on UNIX/Linux/Cloud environment. This could include development, technical QA, and application implementation/support

· Systems troubleshooting and resolution of system and application problems

· Excellent customer facing, communication and interpersonal skills

· Experience with the following:

o J2EE Application Servers – WebSphere / WebLogic / JBoss (including performance benchmark analysis)

o Microsoft Azure or Amazon EC2

o Hazelcast

o Oracle DB (including performance benchmark analysis)

o IBM MQ

o UNIX Shell or Perl Scripting and/or Web Application Server scripting

o Elastic Search

o Kafka (a plus)

o Understanding of UNIX high availability and clustering

· 50% overlap with US hours to support offshore client

· Extensive travel might be required


What can you expect from us?


• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.


What do we offer?


  • TCS Benefits – Brazil:
  • Health insurance
  • Dental Plan
  • Life insurance
  • Transportation vouchers
  • Meal/Food Voucher
  • Childcare assistance
  • Gympass
  • TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates
  • Partnership with SESC
  • Reimbursement of Certifications
  • Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training
  • International experience opportunity
  • Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools
  • Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire
  • TCS Gems – Recognition for performance
  • Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform


At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

title: Desenvolvedor Fullstack Pleno
description:
A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital. Somos globais, somos GPTW.


Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys! Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD). Caso você se enquadre ou conheça alguém com o perfil, a Foursys é a empresa ideal!


Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:


Vaga Desenvolvedor Fullstack Pleno


Responsabilidades e Atribuições:




Domínio em .NET Core versões 3, 6 e 8, atuando no desenvolvimento de serviços,

APIs e aplicações distribuídas com boas práticas de arquitetura e

programação.

o Conhecimentos em Node.js 16, envolvendo criação de serviços, APIs e

integrações, utilizando frameworks e bibliotecas do ecossistema

JavaScript/TypeScript.

o Experiência com Angular versões 10, 14 e 18

envolvendo desenvolvimento de interfaces responsivas, componentização e

integração com APIs REST.

o Conhecimento intermediário em SQL Server e MongoDB, incluindo

modelagem, consultas, otimização básica e manipulação de dados em

ambientes relacionais e NoSQL.

o Familiaridade com ferramentas e frameworks aceleradores de

desenvolvimento apoiados por IA, como Cursor, RooCode e BMAD,

aplicando-os para aumentar produtividade, padronização e qualidade de

código.




Habilidades Técnicas:


- .NET Core

- Node.js

- Angular

- SQL Server

- MongoDB


Habilidades Comportamentais:


- Proatividade

- Comunicação

- Comprometimento


Modelo de Trabalho: 100% Remoto




E temos também o Clube da Four que oferece ótimas vantagens!


Assistência médica;

VR e VA flexível;

Gympass e Wellz;

Parceria com o SESC;

Descontos em restaurantes;

Descontos em cursos técnicos e de ensinos superior;

Descontos em escolas e plataformas de idiomas.


E aí, aceita o desafio? Então conclua sua candidatura e #VemSerFoursys! Boa sorte!

title: Software Architect (.NET)
description:
Somos a Vortigo - nascemos com o propósito de criar aplicativos mobile para um mundo em constante movimento, mas não paramos por aí. Ampliamos nossa atuação e hoje desenvolvemos softwares para ajudar empresas e startups no processo de transformação digital.

Nosso time é composto por pessoas apaixonadas por desafios gigantes, mudando a experiência dos usuários a nível global.

Estamos espalhados pelo Brasil e pelo mundo, tocando projetos nacionais e internacionais.

Nosso ambiente é descontraído, com uma cultura horizontal, muita troca de conhecimento, reconhecimento e desafios! Tá afim de fazer parte de tudo isso?

Dá uma olhada no que estamos buscando:


Principais Responsabilidades:

- Pesquisar, testar e engajar a adoção e disseminação de novas tecnologias e padrões de solução;

- Colaborar no desenho e implementação de soluções estratégicas para o negócio;

- Participar no desenvolvimento de novos produtos;

- Participar no desenvolvimento de projetos de APIs;

- Definir métodos de integração entre sistemas legados e novos projetos;

- Apoiar no desenvolvimento técnico dos demais integrantes da equipe.


Habilidades Técnicas:

- Experiência sólida em arquitetura de software (Clean Architecture, Domain Driven Design, Microsserviços, Component Driven Design, etc.);

- Domínio de práticas DevOps e CI/CD, com pipelines automatizados para back, front e mobile (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Bitrise, App Center);

title: [Tech] Especialista em Desenvolvimento Full Stack - .Net
description:
Descrição da vaga

Você terá a oportunidade de impactar diretamente o setor RH. Buscamos um(a) Especialista Full Stack com foco em IA com forte visão de arquitetura e inovação, que será responsável pela gestão e operação de um Consultor digital, atuando como ponto focal para iniciativas de experimentação e aplicação de tecnologias de IA. Este profissional terá como missão fomentar a cultura de IA, promover o uso ético e estratégico da IA, e apoiar colaboradores e equipes na exploração de soluções inteligentes que agreguem valor ao negócio.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Propor soluções conceituais e orientar a implementação de projetos de IA;
  • Experiência prática em projetos de IA, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Processamento de Linguagem Natural e/ou Visão Computacional;
  • Familiaridade com as capacidades e limitações da IA Generativa (ex: LLMs);
  • Integração de modelos de linguagem (LLMs) com APIs e sistemas legados;
  • Conhecimento prático de IA generativa e suas aplicações em negócios;
  • Integrar soluções de IA a sistemas corporativos de ERP, atuando no desenvolvimento back-end e front-end;
  • Implementar e validar POCs (provas de conceito) de novas tecnologias e soluções;
  • Garantir qualidade, segurança, performance e escalabilidade das soluções;
  • Visão sistêmica: entender impactos das decisões técnicas no ecossistema como um todo;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com a Squad conforme os processos ágeis definidos pela empresa, com objetivo de atingir as metas do time;
  • Garantir que as entregas estão em conformidade com as boas práticas e convenções internas;
  • Desenvolver Testes Unitários, Testes Automatizados e Documentar funcionalidades desenvolvidas;
  • Orientar e atuar junto ao time de desenvolvimento na definição de soluções de negócio e arquitetura, por meio de pesquisas e trocas de conhecimento com áreas parceiras.Manter a qualidade do software verificando os processos, ferramentas e boas práticas disponíveis para o produto e tecnologia utilizados;
  • Orientar desenvolvedores de menor senioridade apoiando suas dúvidas, disseminando seu conhecimento, desenhando e arquitetando soluções ou indicando documentação de apoio.


Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Boa lógica de programação e princípios SOLID;
  • Conhecimento em Back-end (c#, .Net);
  • Conhecimento em Front-end (Angular/TypeScript);
  • Graduação completa em Computação, Engenharia, Dados ou áreas correlatas;
  • Domínio de IA/ML (NLP, LLMs, classificação e extração de entidades) e capacidade analítica para traduzir problemas de negócio em soluções de IA;
  • Engenharia de prompts, MCP, RAG, pipelines, modelos supervisionados e não supervisionados;
  • Experiência com projetos de IA Generativa;
  • Banco de Dados: SQL e NoSQL;
  • Controle de Versão: Git e ferramentas associadas (Repos, GitHub, GitLab);
  • APIs e configuração e manutenção de pipelines de CI/CD;
  • Noções de segurança da informação e boas práticas para desenvolvimento seguro;
  • Conhecimento em Processo Ágil, DevOps e plataformas Cloud (Azure).


Requisitos desejáveis:

  • Conhecimento em Protheus;
  • Conhecimento em PO-UI.

title: English Teacher with Advanced Portuguese Skills
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Desenvolvedor AEM, Senior
description:
Newfold Digital empowers the world’s business owners, content publishers, and those with ideas to control their online destiny with power and confidence. We enable everyone to be able to establish their online presence.


From buying a domain and setting up a website, to growing their business and presence online, we come together to make sure small businesses have all the tools and support they need to achieve their goals.


The Newfold family of brands includes: Bluehost , Web.com, Register.com, HostGator and Domain.com, among others.


What you’ll do & how you’ll make your mark.

  • Develop and maintain reusable front-end components in Adobe Experience Manager (AEM).
  • Work with AEM components and templates, including integrating front-end code with AEM's rendering system.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including designers, back-end developers to deliver digital experiences.


Who you are & what you’ll need to succeed.

  • Advanced English skills .
  • Strong proficiency in HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/TypeScript, and responsive web design principles.
  • Experience integrating Front-end code with AEM components, templates, and workflows.
  • Familiarity with AEM Sightly (HTL) and Sling models and AEM ecosystem.
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively in a team environment.


Why you'll love us

  • We offer a 100% remote position with a monthly home office allowance of R$180.00 and an additional allowance for purchasing items for your office.
  • We provide Meal Vouchers or Food Vouchers worth R$44.55 per working day.
  • Health and dental insurance with no co-payment for employees.
  • Well-being program: Gympass, online meditation, and telemedicine!
  • Do you have a dog, cat, rabbit, hamster, goat, turtle, or even a mini dragon? We have a partnership for pet health insurance!
  • Educational platform: you can pursue undergraduate and graduate degrees, language courses (and much more!) at over 100 educational institutions for a very affordable price!
  • Life insurance.
  • Free website hosting.

Founded in 2018, BingX is a leading cryptocurrency exchange, serving over 40 million users worldwide. BingX offers diversified products and services, including spot, derivatives, copy trading, and asset management – all designed for the evolving needs of users, from beginners to professionals.


BingX is committed to providing a trustworthy platform that empowers users with innovative tools and features to elevate their trading proficiency.

  • Formulate business development plans, assist the team in completing the introduction, negotiation, cooperation, and signing of business cooperation projects

  • Build partnerships with KOLs or crypto projects, and promote cooperation with each other
  • Conduct research to identify new markets and customer needs
  • Build long-term relationships with new and existing KOL/clients

  • Open to fresh graduates or part-time Business Development
  • Highly motivated, proactive, and passionate about achieving results
  • A good understanding of crypto markets is a plus
  • Proficiency in English and Portuguese is essential


Working at BingX


  • Join an international and diversified team
  • Great career development in a fast-growing company
  • Be part of the future of finance technology and achieve meaningful goals
  • Competitive market salary and fully remote/work-from-home flexibility
  • Flexibility to observe your local holiday calendar, alongside additional benefits

title: Senior Technical Recruiter
description:
Title: Senior Technical Recruiter (Contractor / PJ)

Duration: 12 months (with potential extension)


Overview :

Our client is seeking a Senior Recruiter to support US-based clients in a fast-paced staffing environment. This role requires strong English communication, experience working directly with US stakeholders, and the ability to manage high-volume recruiting across multiple requisitions.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Manage full lifecycle recruiting (intake → sourcing → screening → submission → interview → offer → close)
  • Support US-based hiring managers and account teams
  • Handle high-volume req loads (20–40+ open roles depending on complexity)
  • Recruit across technical and/or professional roles
  • Work within ATS/VMS systems (including high-touch / low-touch / no-touch environments)
  • Maintain strong pipeline activity and candidate engagement
  • Ensure high-quality submissions with strong attention to detail


Requirements:

  • 5+ years recruiting experience (agency or staffing strongly preferred)
  • Track record of success in Technical Recruiting supporting roles like Software Engineer, DevOps, Solutions Architect, etc.
  • Proven experience supporting US-based clients
  • Strong English (spoken + written)
  • Experience with high-volume recruiting environments
  • Experience working with VMS / MSP models
  • Highly process-driven and organized
  • Supporting customers in the US EST Timezone


Nice to Have:

  • Experience supporting Government or strict compliance accounts
  • Recruiting experience for Retail Operations and/or Creative positions (Graphic Design, Fashion Design, etc.)
  • Metrics-driven mindset (submittals, interviews, placements)

title: Senior Software Engineer (C#/.NET/SQL)
description:
We are looking for a remote, full-time Senior Software Engineer with 7+ years of software development experience to join the engineering team of our U.S. client. This engineer will contribute to the development of OrderAI, an AI-powered system that allows restaurants to take customer orders through voice interactions.

This role involves working on customer-focused products backed by LLM technologies, including real-time voice interfaces. The engineer will be able to contribute at any point in the full development cycle from the identification of system requirements and enhancements, coding the system to address these requirements, testing the system for quality control, releasing system changes, and documentation of system changes. The ideal candidate is expected to contribute to a positive engineering culture and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.

Founded in 2003, our client transforms the traditional restaurant point-of-sale (POS) terminal into an integrated 360-degree operational management system. Their solution increases brand loyalty through improved customer experiences, optimizes operations resulting in lower costs, and increases sales volumes through comprehensive analytics and employee performance insights. Over 7,000 locations use their technology today processing $5 Billion in daily sales.


Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with engineering teams to design, develop, and support existing systems as well as create new functionality for the OrderAI platform, with a focus on LLM-powered features, including building AI features, integrating LLM APIs, and working with prompts and voice systems
  • Write high-quality code following best practices and standards for coding, compliance, security, and performance using C#/.NET
  • Contribute to software development with an emphasis on backend design, quality, and implementation
  • Utilize the latest advances in AI and LLM technologies to improve the effectiveness of delivering business value within the AI ordering platform
  • Support and share knowledge with fellow engineers through code reviews and collaboration
  • Help troubleshoot issues and identify bug fixes across systems that support AI voice ordering and backend integrations


Required Experience

  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills
  • 7+ years of professional software development experience
  • Knowledge of Microsoft technologies including C# and Azure
  • Familiarity with database technologies such as SQL Server and PostgreSQL
  • Experience with queues, caching, CDNs, and other technologies used for building scalable applications
  • Demonstrated success delivering SaaS, e-commerce, or consumer-facing applications/APIs
  • Experience with distributed systems, cloud environments (Azure preferred), and modern architectures
  • Demonstrated ability to work individually as well as part of a team
  • Interest in working with LLM technologies and AI-driven products


Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Exposure to LLM-powered systems or AI-driven applications
  • Experience integrating LLM APIs or AI services into backend systems
  • Interest in building products that leverage voice-based or conversational interfaces
  • Experience supporting real-time or event-driven systems


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!
